meta.meaning_hi: तुम दोनों कहाँ से आ रहे हो?

blocks.markdown: In do bir tenj chalag kana, sahan lagid.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱤᱨ ᱛᱮᱧ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ, ᱥᱟᱦᱟᱱ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ।
blocks.textLatin: In do bir tenj chalag kana, sahan lagid.

meta.textBengali: ইঞ দ বির তেঞ চালাঃ কানা, সাহান লাগিদ।
meta.textHindi: इञ द बिर तेञ चालाग काना, साहान लागिद।
meta.textOdia: ଇଞ ଦ ବିର ତେଞ ଚାଲାଗ କାନା, ସାହାନ ଲାଗିଦ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate looking at a crackling orange campfire, warm light reflecting on a happy, peaceful face. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing tall, head held high, chest slightly out, a bright and self-assured smile.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate exhibiting self-reliance, readiness to learn, and pride in their capabilities.
meta.meaning: I am going to the forest for firewood.
meta.meaning_en: I am going to the forest for firewood.
meta.pronunciation: In do bir tenj chalag kana, sahan lagid.
meta.meaning_hi: मैं जलाऊ लकड़ी के लिए जंगल जा रहा हूँ।

blocks.markdown: Amaag atu re do sapha dag reyag jharna menag aa?
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱚ ᱥᱟᱯᱷᱟ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱡᱷᱟᱨᱱᱟ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ?
blocks.textLatin: Amaag atu re do sapha dag reyag jharna menag aa?

meta.textBengali: আমাঃ আতু রে দ সাফা দাঃ রেয়াঃ ঝারনা মেনাঃ আ?
meta.textHindi: आमाग आतु रे द साफा दाग रेयाग झारना मेनागआ?
meta.textOdia: ଆମାଗ ଆତୁ ରେ ଦ ସାଫା ଦାଗ ରେୟାଗ ଝାରନା ମେନାଗଆ?
meta.imageDirection: Olitun drinking cool, clean water from a traditional clay pot, looking refreshed and happy. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Is there a clean waterfall in your village?
meta.meaning_en: Is there a clean waterfall in your village?
meta.meaning_bn: আপনার গ্রামে একটি পরিষ্কার জলের ঝরনা আছে?
meta.pronunciation: Amaag atu re do sapha dag reyag jharna menag aa?
meta.meaning_hi: क्या आपके गाँव में कोई स्वच्छ झरना है?
meta.meaning_or: ତୁମ ଗାଁରେ ଏକ ପରିଷ୍କାର ଜଳପ୍ରପାତ ଅଛି କି?

blocks.markdown: Hẽ, ale atu re adi sibil dag jharna menag aa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱦᱮᱸ, ᱟᱞᱮ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱥᱤᱵᱤᱞ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱡᱷᱟᱨᱱᱟ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Hẽ, ale atu re adi sibil dag jharna menag aa.

meta.textBengali: হেঁ, আলে আতু রে আডি সিবিল দাঃ ঝারনা মেনাগআ।
meta.textHindi: हेँ, आले आतु रे आडि सिबिल दाग झारना मेनाग आ।
meta.textOdia: ହେଁ, ଆଲେ ଆତୁ ରେ ଆଡି ସିବିଲ ଦାଗ ଝାରନା ମେନାଗଆ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate drinking cool, clean water from a traditional clay pot, looking refreshed and happy. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Focused and attentive expression, steady hands working carefully, steady stance.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate taking charge of duties, caring for the environment or community.
meta.meaning: Yes, there is a very sweet water spring in our village.
meta.pronunciation: Hẽ, ale atu re adi sibil dag jharna menag aa.
meta.meaning_en: Yes, there is a very sweet water spring in our village.
meta.meaning_bn: হ্যাঁ, আমাদের গ্রামে খুব মিষ্টি জলের ঝর্ণা আছে।
meta.meaning_hi: हाँ, हमारे गाँव में एक बहुत ही मीठे पानी का झरना है।
meta.meaning_or: ହଁ, ଆମ ଗାଁ ରେ ବହୁତ ସୁନ୍ଦର ଜଳ ପ୍ରପାତ ଅଛି।

blocks.markdown: Inj do daka ar utu jom kate kami tenj chalag aa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱫᱟᱠᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱩᱛᱩ ᱡᱚᱢ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱛᱮᱧ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜᱼᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Inj do daka ar utu jom kate kami tenj chalag aa.

meta.textBengali: ইঞ দ দাকা আর উতু জম কাতে কামি তেঞ চালাঃ আ।
meta.textHindi: इञ द दाका आर उतु जम काते कामि तेञ चाला: आ।
meta.textOdia: ଇଞ୍ ଦଃ ଦାକା ଉତୁ ଜମ୍ କାତେ କାମି ତେଞ୍ ଚାଲାଗ୍ ଆ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun carefully carrying out a task, like neatly filing books or designing a wooden model. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing tall, head held high, chest slightly out, a bright and self-assured smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun exhibiting self-reliance, readiness to learn, and pride in their capabilities.
meta.meaning: After eating rice and curry, I will go to my work.
meta.pronunciation: Inj do daka ar utu jom kate kami tenj chalag aa.
meta.meaning_en: After eating rice and curry, I will go to my work.
meta.meaning_hi: चावल-कढ़ी खाकर अपने काम पर जाऊंगा.
meta.meaning_or: ମୁଁ ଭାତ ତରକାରୀ ଖାଇ କାମକୁ ଯିବି।

blocks.markdown: Napay te kami me gate, tehena din sagun sagun kog tam ma.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱛᱮ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱢᱮ ᱜᱟᱛᱮ, ᱛᱮᱦᱮᱧᱟᱜ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱩᱱ ᱠᱚᱜ ᱛᱟᱢ ᱢᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Napay te kami me gate, tehena din sagun sagun kog tam ma.

meta.textBengali: নাপায় তে কামি মে গাতে, তেহেঞাঃ দিন সাগুন কঃ  তাম মা।
meta.textHindi: नापाय ते कामि मे गाते, तेहेञाग दिन सागुन कग ताम मा।
meta.textOdia: ନାପାୟ ତେ କାମି ମେ ଗାତେ, ତେହେଞାଗ ଦିନ ସାଗୁନ କଗ ତାମ ମା।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate smiling warmly while pointing happily toward the learner, conveying friendship and belonging. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing tall, head held high, chest slightly out, a bright and self-assured smile.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate exhibiting self-reliance, readiness to learn, and pride in their capabilities.
meta.meaning: Work well friend, have an auspicious day.
meta.meaning_en: Work well friend, have an auspicious day.
meta.meaning_bn: ভাল করে কাজ করো বন্ধু, তোমার দিনটি শুভ হোক।
meta.pronunciation: Napay te kami me gate, tehena din sagun sagun kog tam ma.
meta.meaning_hi: अच्छे से काम करो मित्र, आपका दिन शुभ हो।
meta.meaning_or: ଭଲ କାମ କରନ୍ତୁ ବନ୍ଧୁ, ଶୁଭ ଦିନ କରନ୍ତୁ |

blocks.markdown: Dare ge jiwi kana, onate dare banchaw do abowaag dhorom kana.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱫᱟᱨᱮ ᱜᱮ ᱡᱤᱣᱤ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱫᱟᱨᱮ ᱵᱟᱧᱪᱟᱣ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱵᱚᱣᱟᱜ ᱫᱷᱚᱨᱚᱢ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Dare ge jiwi kana, onate dare banchaw do abowaag dhorom kana.

meta.textBengali: দারে গে জিওয়ি কানা, অনাতে দারে বাঞচাওয় দ আবওয়াগ ধরম কানা।
meta.textHindi: दारे गे जिवि काना, अनाते दारे बाञचाव द आबवाग धरम काना।
meta.textOdia: ଦାରେ ଗେ ଜିୱି କାନା, ଅନାତେ ଦାରେ ବାଞଚାୱ ଦ ଆବୱାଗ ଧରମ କାନା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun holds a ripe, bright red pomegranate, showing its rich color with a proud and happy smile. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Trees are life, therefore protecting trees is our sacred duty.
meta.pronunciation: Dare ge jiwi kana, onate dare banchaw do abowaag dhorom kana.
meta.meaning_en: Trees are life, therefore protecting trees is our sacred duty.
meta.meaning_bn: গাছই প্রাণ, তাই গাছ বাঁচানো আমাদের পবিত্র ধর্ম।
meta.meaning_hi: पेड़ ही जीवन हैं, इसलिए पेड़ों की रक्षा हमारा कर्तव्य है।
meta.meaning_or: ଗଛ ହିଁ ଜୀବନ, ତେଣୁ ଗଛ ବଞ୍ଚାଇବା ଆମର ପବିତ୍ର ଧର୍ମ।

blocks.markdown: Goj hor do baku rora, onate hola katha do hirinj me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱜᱚᱡ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱹᱠᱩ ᱨᱚᱲᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱦᱚᱞᱟ ᱠᱟᱛᱷᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱦᱤᱲᱤᱧ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Goj hor do baku rora, onate hola katha do hirinj me.

meta.textBengali: গজ হড় দ বাকু রড়া, অনাতে হলা কাথা দ হিড়িঞ মে।
meta.textHindi: गज हड़ द बाकु रड़ा, अनाते हला काथा द हिड़िञ मे।
meta.textOdia: ଗଜ ହଡ଼ ଦ ବାକୁ ରଡ଼ା, ଅନାତେ ହଲା କାଥା ଦ ହିଡ଼ିଞ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate gestures toward a village map drawn on a board, explaining a plan to classmates with confidence. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Dead people do not speak, so forget about yesterday's matters.
meta.pronunciation: Goj hor do baku rora, onate hola katha do hirinj me.
meta.meaning_en: Dead people do not speak, so forget about yesterday's matters.
meta.meaning_bn: মৃত মানুষ কথা বলে না, তাই গতকালের কথা ভুলে যাও।
meta.meaning_hi: मरे हुए लोग नहीं बोलते, इसलिए कल की बातें भूल जाओ।
meta.meaning_or: ମୃତ ଲୋକ କଥା କହନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ଗତକାଲିର କଥା ଭୁଲିଯାଅ।

blocks.markdown: Atu hor ge disom hor kana ko, jumid ge abowaag dare kana.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱜᱮ ᱫᱤᱥᱚᱢ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱠᱚ, ᱡᱩᱢᱤᱫᱽ ᱜᱮ ᱟᱵᱚᱣᱟᱜ ᱫᱟᱲᱮ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Atu hor ge disom hor kana ko, jumid ge abowaag dare kana.

meta.textBengali: আতু হড় গে দিসম হড় কানা ক, জুমিদ গে আবওয়াঃ দাড়ে কানা।
meta.textHindi: आतु हड़ गे दिसम हड़ काना क, जुमिद गे आबवाग दाड़े काना।
meta.textOdia: ଆତୁ ହଡ଼ ଗେ ଦିସମ ହଡ଼ କାନା କ, ଜୁମିଦ ଗେ ଆବୱାଗ ଦାଡ଼େ କାନା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun sits in a circle with friends around a small fire, gesturing warmly while sharing a traditional story. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: The villagers are the country's strength; unity is our power.
meta.pronunciation: Atu hor ge disom hor kana ko, jumid ge abowaag dare kana.
meta.meaning_en: The villagers are the country's strength; unity is our power.
meta.meaning_bn: গ্রামের মানুষই দেশের শক্তি; একতাই আমাদের বল।
meta.meaning_hi: ग्रामीण ही देश की ताकत हैं; एकता ही हमारी शक्ति है।
meta.meaning_or: ଗ୍ରାମବାସୀ ହିଁ ଦେଶର ଶକ୍ତି; ଏକତା ହିଁ ଆମର ବଳ।

blocks.markdown: Med  benget kate chalag me, hor re adi dhiri menag aa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱢᱮᱫ ᱵᱮᱸᱜᱮᱫ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱢᱮ, ᱦᱚᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱫᱷᱤᱨᱤ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ.
blocks.textLatin: Med  benget kate chalag me, hor re adi dhiri menag aa.

meta.textBengali: মেদ বেঁগেদ কাতে চালাঃ মে, হর রে আডি ধিরি মেনাঃ আ।
meta.textHindi: मेद लुटुर बेँगेद काते चालाᱺ मे, हर रे आडि धिरि मेनाग आ.
meta.textOdia: ମେଦ ବେଁଗେଦ କାତେ ଚାଲାଗ ମେ, ହର ରେ ଆଡି ଧିରି ମେନାଗଆ.
meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Keep your eyes open; there are many stones on the road.
meta.pronunciation: Med benget kate chalag me, hor re adi dhiri menaga
meta.meaning_en: Keep your eyes open; there are many stones on the road.
meta.meaning_bn: আপনার চোখ খোলা রাখুন; রাস্তায় অনেক পাথর।
meta.meaning_hi: अपनी आँखें खुले रखें; सड़क पर बहुत सारे पत्थर हैं.
meta.meaning_or: ଆଖି ଖୋଲା ରଖ; ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଅନେକ ପଥର ଅଛି।

blocks.markdown: Am jaha lekam rora, am saw hor ho onka ge ko rora.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱢ ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱸ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱢ ᱨᱚᱲᱟ, ᱟᱢ ᱥᱟᱶ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱚᱱᱠᱟ ᱜᱮ ᱠᱚ ᱨᱚᱲᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Am jaha lekam rora, am saw hor ho onka ge ko rora.

meta.textBengali: আম জাহাঁ লেকাম রড়া, আম সাও হড় হঁ অনকা গে ক রড়া।
meta.textHindi: आम जाहाँ लेकाम रड़ा, आम साव हड़ हँ अनका गे क रड़ा।
meta.textOdia: ଆମ ଜାହାଁ ଲେକାମ ରଡ଼ା, ଆମ ସାୱ ହଡ଼ ହଁ ଅନକା ଗେ କ ରଡ଼ା।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate gestures toward a village map drawn on a board, explaining a plan to classmates with confidence. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: As you speak, people will speak with you in the same way.
meta.pronunciation: Am jaha lekam rora, am saw hor ho onka ge ko rora.
meta.meaning_en: As you speak, people will speak with you in the same way.
meta.meaning_bn: আপনি যেভাবে কথা বলবেন, মানুষও আপনার সাথে সেভাবেই কথা বলবে।
meta.meaning_hi: आप जैसा बोलेंगे, लोग भी आपसे वैसे ही बोलेंगे।
meta.meaning_or: ତୁମେ ଯେପରି କହୁଛ, ଲୋକମାନେ ତୁମ ସହିତ ସମାନ ଭାବରେ କଥା ହେବେ |

blocks.markdown: Sohrae porob re ale orag te hijug me, adi napay huyug aa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱚᱦᱨᱟᱭ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱞᱮ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱛᱮ ᱦᱤᱡᱩᱜ ᱢᱮ, ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Sohrae porob re ale orag te hijug me, adi napay huyug aa.

meta.textBengali: সহরায় পরব রে আলে অড়াগ তে হিজুগ মে, আডি নাপায় হুয়ুঃ আ।
meta.textHindi: सहराय परब रे आले अड़ाग ते हिजुग मे, आडि नापाय हुयुगआ।
meta.textOdia: ସହରାୟ ପରବ ରେ ଆଲେ ଅଡ଼ାଗ ତେ ହିଜୁଗ ମେ, ଆଡି ନାପାୟ ହୁୟୁଗଆ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun sits in a circle with friends around a small fire, gesturing warmly while sharing a traditional story. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Come to our home during the Sohrae festival, it will be wonderful.
meta.pronunciation: Sohrae porob re ale orag te hijug me, adi napay huyug aa.
meta.meaning_en: Come to our home during the Sohrae festival, it will be wonderful.
meta.meaning_bn: সহরায় উৎসবের সময় আমাদের বাড়িতে আসুন, চমৎকার হবে।
meta.meaning_hi: सोहराए पर्व पर हमारे घर आइए, अद्भुत होगा।
meta.meaning_or: ସୋହରା ପର୍ବ ସମୟରେ ଆମ ଘରକୁ ଆସ, ଏହା ଚମତ୍କାର ହେବ |

blocks.markdown: Guru kolom te ol me, geyan hor re lahag me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱜᱩᱨᱩ ᱠᱚᱞᱚᱢ ᱛᱮ ᱚᱞ ᱢᱮ, ᱜᱮᱭᱟᱱ ᱦᱚᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱞᱟᱦᱟᱜ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Guru kolom te ol me, geyan hor re lahag me.

meta.textBengali: গুরু কলম তে অল মে, গেয়ান হর রে লাহাঃ মে।
meta.textHindi: गुरु कलम ते अल मे, गेयान हर रे लाहाग मे।
meta.textOdia: ଗୁରୁ କଲମ ତେ ଅଲ ମେ, ଗେୟାନ ହର ରେ ଲାହାଗ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate writing clean Ol Chiki characters on a blackboard with chalk, standing tall with confidence. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Write with the Guru's pen, advance on the path of knowledge.
meta.pronunciation: Guru kolom te ol me, geyan hor re lahag me.
meta.meaning_en: Write with the Guru's pen, advance on the path of knowledge.
meta.meaning_bn: গুরুর কলম দিয়ে লিখুন, জ্ঞানের পথে এগিয়ে চলুন।
meta.meaning_hi: गुरु की कलम से लिखो, ज्ञान पथ पर आगे बढ़ो।
meta.meaning_or: ଗୁରୁଙ୍କ କଲମ ସହିତ ଲେଖ, ଜ୍ଞାନ ପଥରେ ଅଗ୍ରଗତି କର |

blocks.markdown: Ari chali ar lakchar do abowaag uprum kana, ona do banchaw kag me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱪᱟᱹᱞᱤ ᱟᱨ ᱞᱟᱠᱪᱟᱨ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱵᱚᱣᱟᱜ ᱩᱯᱨᱩᱢ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱧᱪᱟᱣ ᱠᱟᱜ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Ari chali ar lakchar do abowaag uprum kana, ona do banchaw kag me.

meta.textBengali: আরি চালি আর লাকচার দ আবওয়াঃ উপরুম কানা, অনা দ বাঞচাও কাঃ মে।
meta.textHindi: आरि चालि आर लाकचार द आबवाग उपरुम काना, अना द बाञचाव काग मे।
meta.textOdia: ଆରି ଚାଲି ଆର ଲାକଚାର ଦ ଆବୱାଗ ଉପରୁମ କାନା, ଅନା ଦ ବାଞଚାୱ କାଗ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Customs and culture are our identity; protect them well.
meta.pronunciation: Ari chali ar lakchar do abowaag uprum kana, ona do banchaw kag me.
meta.meaning_en: Customs and culture are our identity; protect them well.
meta.meaning_bn: প্রথা ও সংস্কৃতি আমাদের পরিচয়; তাদের ভালভাবে রক্ষা করুন।
meta.meaning_hi: रीति-रिवाज और संस्कृति हमारी पहचान है; उनकी अच्छे से रक्षा करें.
meta.meaning_or: ରୀତିନୀତି ଏବଂ ସଂସ୍କୃତି ଆମର ପରିଚୟ; ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ରକ୍ଷା କର |

blocks.markdown: Herem ror te sanam horag mone jitkar me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱦᱮᱲᱮᱢ ᱨᱚᱲ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱦᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱢᱚᱱᱮ ᱡᱤᱛᱠᱟᱹᱨ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Herem ror te sanam horag mone jitkar me.

meta.textBengali: হেড়েম রড় তে সানাম হড় মনে জিতকার মে।
meta.textHindi: हेड़ेम रड़ ते सानाम हड़ाग मने जितकार मे।
meta.textOdia: ହେଡ଼େମ ରଡ଼ ତେ ସାନାମ ହଡ଼ାଗ ମନେ ଜିତକାର ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate gestures toward a village map drawn on a board, explaining a plan to classmates with confidence. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Win everyone's heart with sweet and fluent speech.
meta.meaning_en: Win everyone's heart with sweet and fluent speech.
meta.meaning_bn: মিষ্টি ও সাবলীল কথাবার্তায় সবার মন জয় করুন।
meta.meaning_hi: मधुर और धाराप्रवाह वाणी से सबका दिल जीतें।
meta.meaning_or: ମିଠା କଥାରେ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ମନ ଜିତି ନିଅ।
meta.pronunciation: Herem ror te sanam horag mone jitkar me.

blocks.markdown: Sirjoniya do nowa dharti adi chehra te sajaw akadai.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱤᱨᱡᱚᱱᱤᱭᱟᱹ ᱫᱚ ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱫᱷᱟᱹᱨᱛᱤ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱪᱮᱦᱨᱟ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱟᱡᱟᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱫᱟᱭ।
blocks.textLatin: Sirjoniya do nowa dharti adi chehra te sajaw akadai.

meta.textBengali: সিরজনিয়া দ নোওয়া ধারতি আডি চেহরা তে সাজাওয় আকাদায়।
meta.textHindi: सिरजनिया द नोवा धारति आडि चेहरा ते साजाव आकादाय।
meta.textOdia: ସିରଜନିୟା ଦ ନୋୱା ଧାରତି ଆଡି ଚେହରା ତେ ସାଜାୱ ଆକାଦାୟ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun holding a handful of rich, dark soil, ready to plant seeds, looking hopeful and proud. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: The Creator has decorated this earth beautifully.
meta.pronunciation: Sirjoniya do nowa dharti adi chehra te sajaw akadai.
meta.meaning_en: The Creator has decorated this earth beautifully.
meta.meaning_bn: সৃষ্টিকর্তা এই পৃথিবীকে সুন্দর করে সাজিয়েছেন।
meta.meaning_hi: विधाता ने इस धरती को बहुत सुंदर ढंग से सजाया है।
meta.meaning_or: ସୃଷ୍ଟିକର୍ତ୍ତା ଏହି ପୃଥିବୀକୁ ସୁନ୍ଦର ଭାବରେ ସଜାଇଛନ୍ତି |

blocks.markdown: Amaag jiwi jala re dhiroj dohoy me, mid din sari ge napay huyug aa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱡᱤᱣᱤ ᱡᱟᱞᱟ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱷᱤᱨᱚᱡᱽ ᱫᱚᱦᱚᱭ ᱢᱮ, ᱢᱤᱫ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱜᱮ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ
blocks.textLatin: Amaag jiwi jala re dhiroj dohoy me, mid din sari ge napay huyug aa.

meta.textBengali: আমাঃ জিওয়ি জালা রে ধিরজ দহয় মে, মিদ দিন সারি গে নাপায় হুয়ুঃ আ।
meta.textHindi: आमाग जिवि जाला रे धिरज दहय मे, मिद दिन सारि गे नापाय हुयुगआ।
meta.textOdia: ଆମାଗ୍ ଜୀୱୀ ଜାଲା ରେ ଧୀରଜ୍ ଦହୟ ମେ, ମିଦ୍ ଦିନ୍ ସାରି ଗେ ନାପାୟ୍ ହୁୟୁଗ୍-ଆ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate stands proudly at a crossroads in the village, pointing toward a path of opportunity. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Keep patience in your life struggles; one day it will surely be good.
meta.pronunciation: Amaag jiwi jala re dhiroj dohoy me, mid din sari ge napay huyug aa.
meta.meaning_en: Keep patience in your life struggles; one day it will surely be good.
meta.meaning_bn: আপনার জীবন সংগ্রামে ধৈর্য ধরে রাখুন; একদিন নিশ্চয়ই ভালো হবে।
meta.meaning_hi: अपने जीवन के संघर्षों में धैर्य रखें; एक दिन जरूर अच्छा होगा.
meta.meaning_or: ଆମର ଜୀବନ ଜାଲରେ ଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟ ରଖ, ଦିନେ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଭଲ ହେବ।

blocks.markdown: Disom daran kate adi lekan geyan em njam dareyag aa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱫᱤᱥᱚᱢ ᱫᱟᱨᱟᱱ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱱ ᱜᱮᱭᱟᱱ ᱮᱢ ᱧᱟᱢ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Disom daran kate adi lekan geyan em njam dareyag aa.

meta.textBengali: দিসম দারান কাতে আডি লেকান গেয়ান এম ঞাম দাড়েয়াঃ আ।
meta.textHindi: दिसम दारान काते आडि लेकान गेयान एम ञाम दाड़ेयागआ।
meta.textOdia: ଦିସମ ଦାରାନ କାତେ ଆଡି ଲେକାନ ଗେୟାନ ଏମ ଞାମ ଦାଡ଼େୟାଗଆ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: By traveling the country, you can gain many kinds of knowledge.
meta.pronunciation: Disom daran kate adi lekan geyan em njam dareyag aa.
meta.meaning_en: By traveling the country, you can gain many kinds of knowledge.
meta.meaning_bn: দেশ ভ্রমণ করে আপনি অনেক ধরণের জ্ঞান অর্জন করতে পারেন।
meta.meaning_hi: देश भर में भ्रमण करके आप कई प्रकार का ज्ञान प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
meta.meaning_or: ଦେଶ ଭ୍ରମଣ କରି ଆପଣ ଅନେକ ପ୍ରକାରର ଜ୍ଞାନ ହାସଲ କରିପାରିବେ |

blocks.markdown: Dhorom kami re mone lagaw me, sanam hor man ko emama.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱫᱷᱚᱨᱚᱢ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱚᱱᱮ ᱞᱟᱜᱟᱣ ᱢᱮ, ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱢᱟᱹᱱ ᱠᱚ ᱮᱢᱟᱢᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Dhorom kami re mone lagaw me, sanam hor man ko emama.

meta.textBengali: ধরম কামি রে মনে লাগাও মে, সানাম হড় মান ক এমামা।
meta.textHindi: धरम कामि रे मने लागाव मे, सानाम हड़ मान क एमामा।
meta.textOdia: ଧରମ କାମି ରେ ମନେ ଲାଗାୱ ମେ, ସାନାମ ହଡ଼ ମାନ କ ଏମାମା।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate pointing toward a balanced, hand-carved wooden scale, indicating fairness and justice. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Engage in righteous deeds; everyone will respect you.
meta.pronunciation: Dhorom kami re mone lagaw me, sanam hor man ko emama.
meta.meaning_en: Engage in righteous deeds; everyone will respect you.
meta.meaning_bn: সৎ কাজে নিয়োজিত হও; সবাই তোমাকে সম্মান করবে।
meta.meaning_hi: नेक कामों में लग जाओ; हर कोई आपका सम्मान करेगा.
meta.meaning_or: ଧାର୍ମିକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟରେ ନିୟୋଜିତ ହୁଅ; ସମସ୍ତେ ତୁମକୁ ସମ୍ମାନ କରିବେ |

blocks.markdown: Santali sawhet do adi kisarh ar gahir geya.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱥᱟᱶᱦᱮᱫ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱠᱤᱥᱟᱹᱬ ᱟᱨ ᱜᱟᱹᱦᱤᱨ ᱜᱮᱭᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Santali sawhet do adi kisarh ar gahir geya.

meta.textBengali: সানতাড়ি সাওয়হেদ দ আডি কিসাড় আর গাহির গেয়া।
meta.textHindi: सानताड़ि सावहेद द आडि किसाण आर गाहिर गेया।
meta.textOdia: ସାନତାଡ଼ି ସାୱହେଦ ଦ ଆଡି କିସାଣ ଆର ଗାହିର ଗେୟା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun sits in a circle with friends around a small fire, gesturing warmly while sharing a traditional story. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Santali literature is very rich and deep.
meta.pronunciation: Santali sawhet do adi kisan ar gahir geya.
meta.meaning_en: Santali literature is very rich and deep.
meta.meaning_bn: সাঁওতালি সাহিত্য অত্যন্ত সমৃদ্ধ ও গভীর।
meta.meaning_hi: संताली साहित्य अत्यंत समृद्ध एवं गहन है।
meta.meaning_or: ସାନ୍ତାଳୀ ସାହିତ୍ୟ ବହୁତ ଧନୀ ଏବଂ ଗଭୀର |

blocks.markdown: Olog parhaw kate amaag atu ar disom reyag nyutum marshal me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱚᱞᱚᱜ ᱯᱟᱲᱦᱟᱣ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱟᱨ ᱫᱤᱥᱚᱢ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱧᱩᱛᱩᱢ ᱢᱟᱨᱥᱟᱞ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Olog parhaw kate amaag atu ar disom reyag nyutum marshal me.

meta.textBengali: অলঃ পাড়হাওয় কাতে আমাঃ আতু আর দিসম রেয়াঃ ঞুতুম মারসাল মে।
meta.textHindi: अलग पाड़हाव काते आमाग आतु आर दिसम रेयाग ञुतुम मारसाल मे।
meta.textOdia: ଅଲଗ ପାଡ଼ହାୱ କାତେ ଆମାଗ ଆତୁ ଆର ଦିସମ ରେୟାଗ ଞୁତୁମ ମାରସାଲ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate holding a shiny, polished brass plate that reflects the morning sunlight with brilliant rays. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: By studying well, brighten the name of your village and country.
meta.pronunciation: Olog parhaw kate amaag atu ar disom reyag nyutum marshal me.

blocks.textLatin: Sari mone te kami me, sirjoniya asis e emama.

meta.meaning_hi: शुभ पत्ते के माध्यम से ग्रामीणों को नए शुभ संकेत मिलते हैं।
meta.meaning_or: ଶୁଭ ପତ୍ର ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଗ୍ରାମବାସୀ ନୂତନ ଶୁଭ ସଂକେତ ପାଆନ୍ତି।

blocks.textLatin: Manmi geyan te nowa dharti adi napay te chalag kana.

meta.textHindi: मानमि गेयान ते नोवा धारति आडि नापाय ते चालाग काना।
meta.textOdia: ମାନମି ଗେୟାନ ତେ ନୋୱା ଧାରତି ଆଡି ନାପାୟ ତେ ଚାଲାଗ କାନା।

meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.

meta.meaning_bn: মানুষের জ্ঞানে এই পৃথিবী খুব সুন্দরভাবে চলছে।
meta.meaning_hi: मानवीय बुद्धि से यह पृथ्वी बहुत सुन्दरता से कार्य करती है।
meta.meaning_or: ମାନବୀୟ ଜ୍ଞାନ ସହିତ, ଏହି ପୃଥିବୀ ଅତି ସୁନ୍ଦର ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ |

blocks.markdown: Barij katha ar uihor ko do mone khon kota gidi kag me.

blocks.textLatin: Barij katha ar uihor ko do mone khon kota gidi kag me.

meta.textBengali: গজ গিডি লেকা বাড়িজ কাথা দ মনে খন গিডি কাঃ মে।
meta.textHindi: बाड़िज काथा आर उयहार क द मने खन कटा गिडि काग मे।
meta.textOdia: ବାଡ଼ିଜ କାଥା ଆର ଉୟହାର କ ଦ ମନେ ଖନ କଟା ଗିଡି କାଗ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.

meta.learningMoment: Olitun enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Throw away bad words and bad thoughts from your mind.
meta.pronunciation: Barij katha ar uihor ko do mone khon kota gidi kag me.
meta.meaning_en: Throw away bad words and bad thoughts from your mind.
meta.meaning_bn: খারাপ কথা আর খারাপ চিন্তাগুলো মন থেকে ঝেড়ে ফেলে দাও।
meta.meaning_hi: बुरी बातों और बुरे विचारों को मन से निकाल फेंक दो।

blocks.textLatin: Jiwi tol kate jahay kamiya, uni do jitkarog geyay.

meta.textBengali: জিওয়ি তল কাতে জাহাঁয় কামিয়া, উনি দ জিতকারঃ গেয়ায়।
meta.textHindi: जिवि तल काते जाहाँय कामिया, उनि द जितकारग गेयाय।
meta.textOdia: ଜିୱି ତଲ କାତେ ଜାହାଁୟ କାମିୟା, ଉନି ଦ ଜିତକାରଗ ଗେୟାୟ।

meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Whoever works with dedicated soul is victorious.
meta.pronunciation: Jiwi tol kate jahay kamiya, uni do jitkarog geyay.
meta.meaning_en: Whoever works with dedicated soul is victorious.
meta.meaning_bn: যে নিবেদিত প্রাণ নিয়ে কাজ করে সে বিজয়ী হবেই। ।

blocks.textLatin: Mone thay kate amag geyan hor re lahag me.

meta.textHindi: मने थाय काते आमाग गेयान हर रे लाहाग मे।
meta.textOdia: ମନେ ଥାୟ କାତେ ଆମାଗ ଗେୟାନ ହର ରେ ଲାହାଗ ମେ।

meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.

meta.pronunciation: Mone thay kate amag geyan hor re lahag me.

meta.meaning_bn: দৃঢ় সিদ্ধান্ত নিয়ে আপনার জ্ঞানের পথে অগ্রসর হোন।
meta.meaning_hi: दृढ़ निर्णय के साथ अपने ज्ञान पथ पर आगे बढ़ें।

blocks.textLatin: Michha katha hor alom ere kowa, sari katha ror me.

meta.textBengali: মিছা কাথা তে হড় ক আলম এড়ে কয়া, সারি কাথা গে রড় মে।
meta.textHindi: मिछा काथा ते हड़ क आलम एड़े कया, सारि काथा गे रड़ मे।

meta.meaning_hi: झूठे वादों से लोगों को धोखा मत दो; सच्चाई बयां करो।

blocks.textLatin: Mu te rakab leka rangaw do mone barijai, sant tahen me.

meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.

meta.meaning_en: Excessive anger is bad for the mind, stay calm.

blocks.textLatin: Dhiri leka mone do alom keteja, daya dohoy me.

meta.meaning_en: Do not harden your heart like a stone; keep kindness.

meta.learningMoment: Olitun enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.

meta.meaning_bn: বনের গাছের মতো আমাদের সবাইকে শক্ত হয়ে দাঁড়াতে হবে।

meta.textHindi: सेरमा इपिल लेका आमाग जिवि द सानाम हड़ गेयान ए एमा कवा।
meta.textOdia: ସେରମା ଇପିଲ ଲେକା ଆମାଗ ଜିୱି ଦ ସାନାମ ହଡ଼ ଗେୟାନ ଏ ଏମା କୱା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun lying on a straw mat under a clear night sky, pointing at a shooting star in wonder. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Like stars, let your life give knowledge to everyone.
meta.pronunciation: Serma ipil leka amag jiwi do sanam hor geyan e ema kowa.
meta.meaning_en: Like stars, let your life give knowledge to everyone.
meta.meaning_bn: স্বর্গীয় নক্ষত্রের মতো, আপনার জীবন সবাইকে জ্ঞান দিতে দিন।
meta.meaning_hi: सितारों की तरह, आपका जीवन हर किसी को ज्ञान दे।
meta.meaning_or: ତାରା ପରି, ତୁମ ଜୀବନ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଦେଉ।

blocks.markdown: Njida umul leka barij okto ho mid din paromog geya.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱧᱤᱫᱟᱹ ᱩᱢᱩᱞ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱵᱟᱹᱲᱤᱡ ᱚᱠᱛᱚ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱯᱟᱨᱚᱢᱚᱜ ᱜᱮᱭᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Njida umul leka barij okto ho mid din paromog geya.

meta.textBengali: ঞিদা উমুল লেকা বাড়িজ অকত হঁ মিদ দিন পারমঃ গেয়া।
meta.textHindi: ञिदा उमुल लेका बाड़िज अकत हँ मिद दिन पारमग गेया।
meta.textOdia: ଞିଦା ଉମୁଲ ଲେକା ବାଡ଼ିଜ ଅକତ ହଁ ମିଦ ଦିନ ପାରମଗ ଗେୟା।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate gestures toward a village map drawn on a board, explaining a plan to classmates with confidence. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Like the night shadow, bad times will also pass one day.
meta.pronunciation: Njida umul leka barij okto ho mid din paromog geya.
meta.meaning_en: Like the night shadow, bad times will also pass one day.
meta.meaning_bn: রাতের ছায়ার মতো খারাপ সময়ও একদিন কেটে যাবে।
meta.meaning_hi: रात के साये की तरह बुरा वक्त भी एक दिन गुजर जायेगा।
meta.meaning_or: ରାତିର ଛାୟା ପରି ଖରାପ ସମୟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗୋଟିଏ ଦିନ ଅତିକ୍ରମ କରିବ |

blocks.markdown: Singe situng re kami kate hon atu hor do ko landaya.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱤᱸᱜᱮ ᱥᱤᱛᱩᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱫᱚ ᱠᱚ ᱞᱟᱸᱫᱟᱭᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Singe situng re kami kate hon atu hor do ko landaya.

meta.textBengali: সিঁগে সিতুং রে কামি কাতে হঁ আতু হড় দ ক লাঁদায়া।
meta.textHindi: सिँगे सितुङ रे कामि काते हँ आतु हड़ द क लाँदाया।
meta.textOdia: ସିଁଗେ ସିତୁଙ ରେ କାମି କାତେ ହଁ ଆତୁ ହଡ଼ ଦ କ ଲାଁଦାୟା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun looking up at the warm morning sun rising over the hills, eyes filled with hope. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Even working in the scorching sun, the villagers laugh.
meta.pronunciation: Singe situng re kami kate hon atu hor do ko landaya.
meta.meaning_en: Even working in the scorching sun, the villagers laugh.
meta.meaning_bn: প্রখর রোদে কাজ করেও গ্রামবাসীরা হাসে।
meta.meaning_hi: चिलचिलाती धूप में भी काम करते हुए ग्रामीण हंसते हैं।
meta.meaning_or: ଏପରିକି ଖରାଦିନେ କାମ କରି ଗ୍ରାମବାସୀ ହସନ୍ତି।

blocks.markdown: Rimil dag te ot hasa do adi napay te lohodog aa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱨᱤᱢᱤᱞ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱛᱮ ᱚᱛ ᱦᱟᱥᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱛᱮ ᱞᱚᱦᱚᱫᱚᱜᱼᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Rimil dag te ot hasa do adi napay te lohodog aa.

meta.textBengali: রিমিল দাঃ তে অত হাসা দ আডি নাপায় তে লহদগআ।
meta.textHindi: रिमिल दाग ते अत हासा द आडि नापाय ते लहदग आ।
meta.textOdia: ରିମିଲ ଦାଗ ତେ ଅତ ହାସା ଦ ଆଡି ନାପାୟ ତେ ଲହଦଗଆ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate standing under a shelter, watching fresh raindrops fall on green leaves, smiling with curiosity. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: With  rain, the soil gets beautifully soaked.
meta.pronunciation: Rimil dag te ot hasa do adi napay te lohodog aa.
meta.meaning_en: With  rain, the soil gets beautifully soaked.
meta.meaning_hi: बारिश से ज़मीन बहुत अच्छे से गीली हो जाती है।
meta.meaning_or: ବର୍ଷା ଯୋଗୁଁ ମାଟି ବହୁତ ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ଓଦା ହୋଇଯାଏ।

blocks.markdown: Hormo re sari mone doho ge sari manmiyag uprum.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱦᱚᱲᱢᱚ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱢᱚᱱᱮ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱜᱮ ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱢᱟᱹᱱᱢᱤᱭᱟᱜ ᱩᱯᱨᱩᱢ।
blocks.textLatin: Hormo re sari mone doho ge sari manmiyag uprum.

meta.textBengali: হড়ম রে সারি মনে দহ গে সারি মানমিয়াঃ উপরুম।
meta.textHindi: हड़म रे सारि मने दह गे सारि मानमियाग उपरुम।
meta.textOdia: ହଡ଼ମ ରେ ସାରି ମନେ ଦହ ଗେ ସାରି ମାନମିୟାଗ ଉପରୁମ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Keeping a true heart within is the identity of a true human.
meta.pronunciation: Hormo re sari mone doho ge sari manmiyag uprum.
meta.meaning_en: Keeping a true heart within is the identity of a true human.
meta.meaning_bn: মানবদেহে সৎ হৃদয় রাখাই প্রকৃত মানুষের পরিচয়।
meta.meaning_hi: शरीर में सच्चा मन रखना ही सच्चे इंसान की पहचान है।
meta.meaning_or: ଶରୀରରେ ସତ୍ୟ ମନ ରଖିବା ହିଁ ସତ୍ୟ ମଣିଷର ପରିଚୟ।

blocks.markdown: Sibil sagay te atu rin sanam hor jumid menag kowa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱤᱵᱤᱞ ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱟᱹᱭ ᱛᱮ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱤᱱ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱡᱩᱢᱤᱫᱽ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱠᱚᱣᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Sibil sagay te atu rin sanam hor jumid menag kowa.

meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate gestures toward a village map drawn on a board, explaining a plan to classmates with confidence. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.

meta.pronunciation: Sibil sagay te atu rin sanam hor jumid menag kowa.
meta.meaning_en: All the villagers are united with affectionate bonding.
meta.meaning_hi: सभी ग्रामवासी स्नेहपूर्ण बंधन में बंधे हुए हैं।

meta.imageDirection: Olitun sits in a circle with friends around a small fire, gesturing warmly while sharing a traditional story. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Win the battle of your life with a strong mind.
meta.pronunciation: Mone ketej kate amag jiwi reyag larhay re jitkarog me.
meta.meaning_en: Win the battle of your life with a strong mind.
meta.meaning_bn: দৃঢ় মন নিয়ে জীবনের যুদ্ধে জয়ী হও।
meta.meaning_hi: दृढ़  मन से अपने जीवन की लड़ाई जीतें।
meta.meaning_or: ଏକ ଦୃ strong ମନ ସହିତ ତୁମର ଜୀବନର ଯୁଦ୍ଧରେ ଜିତ |

meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Like a cart of love, fill your life with kindness.
meta.pronunciation: Dular gadi leka amag jiwi do daya te perej kag me.
meta.meaning_en: Like a cart of love, fill your life with kindness.
meta.meaning_bn: প্রেমের বাহনের মতো, আপনার জীবনকে দয়ায় পূর্ণ করুন।
meta.meaning_hi: प्रेम के वाहन की तरह, अपने जीवन को दयालुता से भरें।

meta.textBengali: সারি গুরু ওয়াঃ গেয়ান দ আব সানাম হড় সারি হর এ উদুঃ আবওয়া।
meta.textHindi: सारि गुरु वाग गेयान द आब सानाम हड़ सारि हर ए उदुग आबवा।
meta.textOdia: ସାରି ଗୁରୁ ୱାଗ ଗେୟାନ ଦ ଆବ ସାନାମ ହଡ଼ ସାରି ହର ଏ ଉଦୁଗ ଆବୱା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun standing tall on a hill overlooking the village, looking forward with strong resolution. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: The true teacher's knowledge shows all of us the path of truth.

meta.meaning_en: The true teacher's knowledge shows all of us the path of truth.
meta.meaning_bn: প্রকৃত শিক্ষকের জ্ঞান আমাদের সকলকে সত্যের পথ দেখায়।

meta.imageDirection: Olitun sits in a circle with friends around a small fire, gesturing warmly while sharing a traditional story. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.

meta.meaning_hi: ज्ञान के सागर में गोता लगाकर ही सच्चा मोती पाया जा सकता है।
meta.meaning_or: ଜ୍ knowledge ାନର ସମୁଦ୍ରରେ ବୁଲିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଆପଣ ପ୍ରକୃତ ମୋତି ପାଇପାରିବେ |

blocks.markdown: Lakchar hor te chalag ge Santal hopon aag man kana.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱞᱟᱠᱪᱟᱨ ᱦᱚᱨ ᱛᱮ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱜᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲ ᱦᱚᱯᱚᱱ ᱟᱜ ᱢᱟᱹᱱ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Lakchar hor te chalag ge Santal hopon aag man kana.

meta.textBengali: লাকচার হর তে চালাঃ গে সানতাড় হপনাঃ মান কানা।
meta.textHindi: लाकचार हर ते चालाग गे सानताड़ हपन आग मान काना।
meta.textOdia: ଲାକଚାର ହର ତେ ଚାଲାଗ ଗେ ସାନତାଡ଼ ହପନ ଆଗ ମାନ କାନା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Going on the cultural path is the honor of the Santal people.
meta.pronunciation: Lakchar hor te chalag ge Santal hoponag man kana.
meta.meaning_en: Going on the cultural path is the honor of the Santal people.
meta.meaning_bn: সংস্কৃতির পথে চলা সাঁওতাল জাতির গৌরব।
meta.meaning_hi: संस्कृति के मार्ग पर चलना संताल समाज का गौरव है।
meta.meaning_or: ସଂସ୍କୃତିର ବାଟରେ ଚାଲିବା ସାନ୍ତାଳ ଜାତିର ଗୌରବ।

blocks.markdown: Ari sari te jiwi khandaw ge dhorom kana.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱡᱤᱣᱤ ᱠᱷᱟᱸᱰᱟᱣ ᱜᱮ ᱫᱷᱚᱨᱚᱢ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Ari sari te jiwi khandaw ge dhorom kana.

meta.textBengali: আরি সারি তে জিওয়ি খাঁডাওয় গে ধরম কানা।
meta.textHindi: आरि सारि ते जिवि खाँडाव गे धरम काना।
meta.textOdia: ଆରି ସାରି ତେ ଜିୱି ଖାଁଡାୱ ଗେ ଧରମ କାନା।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate pointing toward a balanced, hand-carved wooden scale, indicating fairness and justice. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Living life with pure traditions is righteousness.
meta.pronunciation: Ari sari te jiwi khandaw ge dhorom kana.
meta.meaning_en: Living life with pure traditions is righteousness.
meta.meaning_bn: পবিত্র পরম্পরা অনুসারে জীবনযাপন করাই প্রকৃত ধর্ম।
meta.meaning_hi: पवित्र परंपराओं के अनुसार जीवन जीना ही धर्म है।
meta.meaning_or: ପବିତ୍ର ପରମ୍ପରା ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ଜୀବନ ବିତାଇବା ହିଁ ଧର୍ମ।

blocks.markdown: Sawhed do jiwi kana, onate Santali sawhed do banchao dohoy me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱶᱦᱮᱫ ᱡᱤᱣᱤ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱥᱟᱶᱦᱮᱫ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱧᱪᱟᱣ ᱫᱚᱦᱚᱭ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Sawhed do jiwi kana, onate Santali sawhed do banchao dohoy me.

meta.textBengali: সাওয়হেদ দ জিওয়ি কানা, অনাতে সানতাড়ি সাওয়হেদ দ বাঞচাও দহয় মে।
meta.textHindi: सावहेद जिवि काना, अनाते सानताड़ि सावहेद द बाञचाव दहय मे।
meta.textOdia: ସାୱହେଦ ଜିୱି କାନା, ଅନାତେ ସାନତାଡ଼ି ସାୱହେଦ ଦ ବାଞଚାୱ ଦହୟ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun sits in a circle with friends around a small fire, gesturing warmly while sharing a traditional story. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Literature is the soul, therefore preserve Santali literature.
meta.pronunciation: Sawhed do jiwi kana, onate Santali sawhed do banchao dohoy me.
meta.meaning_en: Literature is the soul, therefore preserve Santali literature.
meta.meaning_bn: সাহিত্যই হলো আত্মা, তাই সাঁওতালি সাহিত্য রক্ষা করো।
meta.meaning_hi: साहित्य ही आत्मा है, इसलिए संताली साहित्य का संरक्षण करो।
meta.meaning_or: ସାହିତ୍ୟ ହିଁ ଆତ୍ମା, ତେଣୁ ସାନ୍ତାଳୀ ସାହିତ୍ୟର ସୁରକ୍ଷା କର।

blocks.markdown: Sirjon dhorom lekate dare ar jibjiyali ko dular ko me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱤᱨᱡᱚᱱ ᱫᱷᱚᱨᱚᱢ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱫᱟᱨᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱡᱤᱵᱽᱡᱤᱭᱟᱹᱞᱤ ᱠᱚ ᱫᱩᱞᱟᱹᱲ ᱠᱚ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Sirjon dhorom lekate dare ar jibjiyali ko dular ko me.

meta.textBengali: সিরজন ধরম লেকাতে দারে আর জিবজিয়ালি ক দুলাড় ক মে।
meta.textHindi: सिरजन धरम लेकाते दारे आर जिबजियालि क दुलाड़ क मे।
meta.textOdia: ସିରଜନ ଧରମ ଲେକାତେ ଦାରେ ଆର ଜିବଜିୟାଲି କ ଦୁଲାଡ଼ କ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate planting a young green seedling in rich soil, showing care and responsibility for nature. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: According to the religion of nature, love the trees and animals.
meta.pronunciation: Sirjon dhorom lekate dare ar jibjiyali ko dular ko me.
meta.meaning_en: According to the religion of nature, love the trees and animals.
meta.meaning_bn: প্রকৃতির ধর্ম অনুযায়ী বৃক্ষ ও প্রাণীকে ভালোবাসুন।
meta.meaning_hi: प्रकृति धर्म के अनुसार पेड़-पौधों और जानवरों से प्रेम करें।
meta.meaning_or: ପ୍ରକୃତିର ଧର୍ମ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଗଛ ଏବଂ ପଶୁମାନଙ୍କୁ ଭଲ ପାଅ |

blocks.markdown: Disom dare ge abowag marang dare kana, ona do manaw me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱫᱤᱥᱚᱢ ᱫᱟᱲᱮ ᱜᱮ ᱟᱵᱚᱣᱟᱜ ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱫᱟᱲᱮ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱢᱟᱱᱟᱣ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Disom dare ge abowag marang dare kana, ona do manaw me.

meta.textBengali: দিসম দাড়ে গে আবওয়াঃ মারাং দাড়ে কানা, অনা দ মানাও মে।
meta.textHindi: दिसम दाड़े गे आबवाग माराङ दाड़े काना, अना द मानाव मे।
meta.textOdia: ଦିସମ ଦାଡ଼େ ଗେ ଆବୱାଗ ମାରାଙ ଦାଡ଼େ କାନା, ଅନା ଦ ମାନାୱ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun stands with hands on hips, looking out over the village from a scenic hill, representing leadership. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: The power of the land is our great strength; respect it.
meta.pronunciation: Disom dare ge abowag marang dare kana, ona do manaw me.
meta.meaning_en: The power of the land is our great strength; respect it.
meta.meaning_bn: দেশের শক্তিই আমাদের বড় শক্তি; এটার সম্মান করো।
meta.meaning_hi: देश की शक्ति ही हमारी सबसे बड़ी शक्ति है, उसका सम्मान करो।
meta.meaning_or: ଦେଶର ଶକ୍ତି ହିଁ ଆମର ସବୁଠୁ ବଡ଼ ଶକ୍ତି, ତାକୁ ସମ୍ମାନ କର।

blocks.markdown: Amag sagun nyutum te amag atu reyag nyutum Marshalog ma.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱩᱱ ᱧᱩᱛᱩᱢ ᱛᱮ ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱧᱩᱛᱩᱢ ᱢᱟᱨᱥᱟᱞᱚᱜ ᱢᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Amag sagun nyutum te amag atu reyag nyutum Marshalog ma.

meta.textBengali: আমাঃ সাগুন ঞুতুম তে আমাঃ আতু রেয়াঃ ঞুতুম মারসালঃ মা।
meta.textHindi: आमाग सागुन ञुतुम ते आमाग आतु रेयाग ञुतुम मारसालग मा।
meta.textOdia: ଆମାଗ ସାଗୁନ ଞୁତୁମ ତେ ଆମାଗ ଆତୁ ରେୟାଗ ଞୁତୁମ ମାରସାଲଗ ମା।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate gestures toward a village map drawn on a board, explaining a plan to classmates with confidence. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Let the name of your village shine with your good name.
meta.pronunciation: Amag sagun nyutum te amag atu reyag nyutum Marshalog ma.
meta.meaning_en: Let the name of your village shine with your good name.
meta.meaning_bn: আপনার সুনামের সাথে আপনার গ্রামের নাম উজ্জ্বল হোক।
meta.meaning_hi: आपके अच्छे नाम से आपके गांव का नाम रोशन हो।
meta.meaning_or: ତୁମର ଗାଁର ନାମ ତୁମର ଭଲ ନାମ ସହିତ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ହେଉ |

blocks.markdown: Manmi dhorom ge sanam khon marang dhorom kana, hor seba ko me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱢᱟᱹᱱᱢᱤ ᱫᱷᱚᱨᱚᱢ ᱜᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱫᱷᱚᱨᱚᱢ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ, ᱦᱚᱲ ᱥᱮᱵᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Manmi dhorom ge sanam khon marang dhorom kana, hor seba ko me.

meta.textBengali: মানমি ধরম গে সানাম খন মারাং ধরম কানা, হড় সেবা ক মে।
meta.textHindi: मानमि धरम गे सानाम खन माराङ धरम काना, हड़ सेबा क मे।
meta.textOdia: ମାନମି ଧରମ ଗେ ସାନାମ ଖନ ମାରାଙ ଧରମ କାନା, ହଡ଼ ସେବା କ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun sits in a circle with friends around a small fire, gesturing warmly while sharing a traditional story. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Humanity is the greatest religion of all; serve the people.
meta.pronunciation: Manmi dhorom ge sanam khon marang dhorom kana, hor seba ko me.
meta.meaning_en: Humanity is the greatest religion of all; serve the people.
meta.meaning_bn: মানবতাই সর্বশ্রেষ্ঠ ধর্ম; মানুষের সেবা করো।
meta.meaning_hi: मानवता ही सबसे बड़ा धर्म है; लोगों की सेवा करो.
meta.meaning_or: ମାନବିକତା ହେଉଛି ସର୍ବଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ଧର୍ମ; ଲୋକଙ୍କ ସେବା କର |

blocks.markdown: Amag sibil ror te atu rin sanam horag mone jitkar me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱥᱤᱵᱤᱞ ᱨᱚᱲ ᱛᱮ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱤᱱ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱦᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱢᱚᱱᱮ ᱡᱤᱛᱠᱟᱹᱨ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Amag sibil ror te atu rin sanam horag mone jitkar me.

meta.textBengali: আমাগ সিবিল রড় তে আতু রিন সানাম হড়াঃ মনে জিতকার মে।
meta.textHindi: आमाग सिबिल रड़ ते आतु रिन सानाम हड़ाग मने जितकार मे।
meta.textOdia: ଆମାଗ ସିବିଲ ରଡ଼ ତେ ଆତୁ ରିନ ସାନାମ ହଡ଼ାଗ ମନେ ଜିତକାର ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate stands proudly at a crossroads in the village, pointing toward a path of opportunity. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Win the hearts of all villagers with your sweet words.
meta.pronunciation: Amag sibil ror te atu rin sanam horag mone jitkar me.
meta.meaning_en: Win the hearts of all villagers with your sweet words.
meta.meaning_bn: আপনার মিষ্টি কথায় সমস্ত গ্রামবাসীর মন জয় করুন।
meta.meaning_hi: अपनी मधुर वाणी से सभी ग्रामवासियों का दिल जीतें।
meta.meaning_or: ତୁମର ମଧୁର ଶବ୍ଦ ସହିତ ସମସ୍ତ ଗ୍ରାମବାସୀଙ୍କ ହୃଦୟ ଜିତ |

blocks.markdown: Sari mone te kami lekhan, sanam kami ge sagunog aa.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱢᱚᱱᱮ ᱛᱮ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱞᱮᱠᱷᱟᱱ, ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱜᱮ ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱩᱱᱚᱜ ᱼᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Sari mone te kami lekhan, sanam kami ge sagunog aa.

meta.textBengali: সারি মনে তে কামি লেখান, সানাম কামি গে সাগুনঃ আ।
meta.textHindi: सारि मने ते कामि लेखान, सानाम कामि गे सागुनग आ।
meta.textOdia: ସାରି ମନେ ତେ କାମି ଲେଖାନ, ସାନାମ କାମି ଗେ ସାଗୁନଗ ଆ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun looking forward toward a modern skyline in the distance, eyes filled with determination and hope. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Slightly bowed head, hands held together or offering a token of appreciation, warm smile.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: If worked with an honest heart, all work will be successful.
meta.pronunciation: Sari mone te kami lekhan, sanam kami ge sagunog aa.
meta.meaning_en: If worked with an honest heart, all work will be successful.
meta.meaning_bn: সৎ চিত্তে কাজ করলে সব কাজই সফল হবে।
meta.meaning_hi: सच्चे मन से काम किया जाए तो सभी काम सफल होंगे।
meta.meaning_or: ଯଦି ଏକ ସଚ୍ଚୋଟ ହୃଦୟ ସହିତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରାଯାଏ, ସମସ୍ତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସଫଳ ହେବ |

blocks.markdown: Tehenj do ale orag re adi napay sibil jom le benaw akada.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱛᱮᱦᱮᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱞᱮ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱥᱤᱵᱤᱞ ᱡᱚᱢ ᱞᱮ ᱵᱮᱱᱟᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱫᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Tehenj do ale orag re adi napay sibil jom le benaw akada.

meta.textBengali: তেহেঞ দ আলে অড়াঃ রে আডি নাপায় সিবিল জম লে বেনাও আকাদা।

meta.textBengali: দিসম দুলাড় গে সারি হড় হপন আঃ মান কানা।
meta.textHindi: दिसम दुलाड़ गे सारि हड़ हपन आग मान काना।
meta.textOdia: ଦିସମ ଦୁଲାଡ଼ ଗେ ସାରି ହଡ଼ ହପନ ଆଗ ମାନ କାନା।
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate stands proudly at a crossroads in the village, pointing toward a path of opportunity. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Patriotism is the honor of a true Santal.
meta.pronunciation: Disom dular ge sari hor hoponag man kana.
meta.meaning_en: Patriotism is the honor of a true Santal.
meta.meaning_hi: देशभक्ति एक सच्चे संताल का सम्मान है.

blocks.markdown: Sari katha ror te am do jiwi re sari santim njama.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱠᱟᱛᱷᱟ ᱨᱚᱲ ᱛᱮ ᱟᱢ ᱫᱚ ᱡᱤᱣᱤ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱤᱢ ᱧᱟᱢᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Sari katha ror te am do jiwi re sari santim njama.

meta.textBengali: সারি কাথা রড় তে আম দ জিওয়ি রে সারি সানতিম ঞামা।
meta.textHindi: सारि काथा रड़ ते आम द जिवि रे सारि सानतिम ञामा।
meta.textOdia: ସାରି କାଥା ରଡ଼ ତେ ଆମ ଦ ଜିୱି ରେ ସାରି ସାନତିମ ଞାମା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun standing tall on a hill overlooking the village, looking forward with strong resolution. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: By speaking the truth, you will find true peace in life.
meta.pronunciation: Sari katha ror te am do jiwi re sari santim njama.
meta.meaning_en: By speaking the truth, you will find true peace in life.
meta.meaning_bn: সত্য কথা বললে আপনি জীবনে প্রকৃত শান্তি পাবেন।
meta.meaning_hi: सत्य बोलने से आपको जीवन में सच्ची शांति मिलेगी।
meta.meaning_or: ସତ୍ୟ କହିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ତୁମେ ଜୀବନରେ ପ୍ରକୃତ ଶାନ୍ତି ପାଇବ |

blocks.markdown: Ale odag re sagun daram!  durub me gate.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱞᱮ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ  ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱩᱱ ᱫᱟᱨᱟᱢ!  ᱫᱩᱲᱩᱵ ᱢᱮ ᱜᱟᱛᱮ.
blocks.textLatin: Ale odag re sagun daram!  durub me gate.

meta.textBengali: সাগুন দারাম!  আলে অড়াঃ রে দুড়ুব মে গাতে.
meta.textHindi: आले अड़ाग रे  सागुन दाराम!  दुड़ुब मे गाते.
meta.textOdia: ଆଲେ ଅଡ଼ାଗ ରେ  ସାଗୁନ ଦାରାମ!  ଦୁଡ଼ୁବ ମେ ଗାତେ.
meta.imageDirection: a young Santhal child classmate smiling warmly while pointing happily toward the learner, conveying friendship and belonging. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: Welcome to our home , have a seat friend.
meta.pronunciation: Ale odag re sagun daram!  durub me gate.
meta.meaning_en: Welcome to our home , have a seat friend.
meta.meaning_hi: हमारे घर में स्वागत है! बैठो मेरे दोस्त।

blocks.markdown: Napay te jiraw kate amag geyan hor re lahag me.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱛᱮ ᱡᱤᱨᱟᱹᱣ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱜᱮᱭᱟᱱ ᱦᱚᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱞᱟᱦᱟᱜ ᱢᱮ।
blocks.textLatin: Napay te jiraw kate amag geyan hor re lahag me.

meta.textBengali: নাপায় তে জিরাওয় কাতে আমাঃ গেয়ান হর রে লাহাঃ মে।
meta.textHindi: नापाय ते जिराव काते आमाग गेयान हर रे लाहाग मे।
meta.textOdia: ନାପାୟ ତେ ଜିରାୱ କାତେ ଆମାଗ ଗେୟାନ ହର ରେ ଲାହାଗ ମେ।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun sits in a circle with friends around a small fire, gesturing warmly while sharing a traditional story. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: Resting well, advance on your path of knowledge.
meta.pronunciation: Napay te jiraw kate amag geyan hor re lahag me.
meta.meaning_en: Resting well, advance on your path of knowledge.
meta.meaning_bn: ভালভাবে বিশ্রাম নিন, আপনার জ্ঞানের পথে এগিয়ে যান।
meta.meaning_hi: अच्छे से आराम करो, अपने ज्ञान पथ पर आगे बढ़ो।
meta.meaning_or: ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ବିଶ୍ରାମ କର, ତୁମର ଜ୍ଞାନ ପଥରେ ଅଗ୍ରଗତି କର |

blocks.markdown: Atu rin hor do jaher than re ko jawra akana.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱤᱱ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱫᱚ ᱡᱟᱦᱮᱨ ᱛᱷᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱠᱚ ᱡᱟᱣᱨᱟ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Atu rin hor do jaher than re ko jawra akana.

meta.textBengali: আতু রিন হড় দ জাহের থান রে ক জাওয়রা আকানা।
meta.textHindi: आतु रिन हड़ द जाहेर थान रे क जावरा आकाना।
meta.textOdia: ଆତୁ ରିନ ହଡ଼ ଦ ଜାହେର ଥାନ ରେ କ ଜାୱରା ଆକାନା।
meta.imageDirection: Olitun holds a ripe, bright red pomegranate, showing its rich color with a proud and happy smile. Show only the speaking character, never show both speakers in the same frame.
meta.bodyLanguage: Standing proud and tall, head high, shoulders back, holding cultural artifacts or projects.
meta.learningMoment: Olitun celebrating cultural identity, heritage, and personal achievements.
meta.meaning: The villagers have gathered at the Jaher Than.
meta.pronunciation: Atu rin hor do jaher than re ko jawra akana.
meta.meaning_en: The villagers have gathered at the Jaher Than.
meta.meaning_hi: गाँव वाले जाहेर थान में इकट्ठा हुए हैं।
meta.meaning_or: ଗାଁ ଲୋକମାନେ ଜାହେର ଥାନରେ ଏକାଠି ହୋଇଛନ୍ତି।

blocks.markdown: Majhi Hadam do atu hor saw e galmaraw kana.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱢᱟᱹᱡᱷᱤ ᱦᱟᱲᱟᱢ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱥᱟᱶ ᱮ ᱜᱟᱞᱢᱟᱨᱟᱣ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Majhi Hadam do atu hor saw e galmaraw kana.

meta.textBengali: মাঝি হাড়াম দ আতু হড় সাও এ গালমারাও কানা।
meta.textHindi: माझि हाड़ाम द आतु हड़ साव ए गालमाराव काना।
meta.textOdia: ମାଝି ହାଡ଼ାମ ଦ ଆତୁ ହଡ଼ ସାୱ ଏ ଗାଲମାରାୱ କାନା।

meta.bodyLanguage: Cheerful smile, hands raised in a small celebration or showing a finished project.
meta.learningMoment: a young Santhal child classmate enjoying the reward of dedication, effort, and hard work.
meta.meaning: The Majhi Hadam is talking with the villagers.
meta.pronunciation: Majhi Hadam do atu hor saw e galmaraw kana.
meta.meaning_en: The Majhi Hadam is talking with the villagers.
meta.meaning_bn: গ্রামের মাঝি হাড়াম গ্রামবাসীদের সাথে কথা বলছেন।
meta.meaning_hi: माझी हराम ग्रामीणों से बात कर रहे हैं।
meta.meaning_or: ମାଝି ହାରାମ ଗାଁ ଲୋକମାନଙ୍କ ସହିତ କଥା ହେଉଛନ୍ତି।

blocks.markdown: Tehenj do adi napay Santali serenj ko serenj eda.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱛᱮᱦᱮᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱥᱮᱨᱮᱧ ᱠᱚ ᱥᱮᱨᱮᱧ ᱮᱫᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Tehenj do adi napay Santali serenj ko serenj eda.

meta.textBengali: তেহেঞ দ আডি নাপায় সানতাড়ি সেরেঞ ক সেরেঞ এদা।
meta.textHindi: तेहेञ द आडि नापाय सानताड़ि सेरेञ क सेरेञ एदा।
meta.textOdia: ତେହେଞ ଦ ଆଡି ନାପାୟ ସାନତାଡ଼ି ସେରେଞ କ ସେରେଞ ଏଦା।

meta.learningMoment: Olitun acknowledging and appreciating the kindness and efforts of others.
meta.meaning: Today they are singing very beautiful Santali songs.
meta.pronunciation: Tehenj do adi napay Santali serenj ko serenj eda.
meta.meaning_en: Today they are singing very beautiful Santali songs.
meta.meaning_bn: আজ তারা খুব সুন্দর সাঁওতালি গান গাইছেন।
meta.meaning_hi: आज वे बहुत सुंदर संताली गीत गा रहे हैं।
meta.meaning_or: ଆଜି ସେମାନେ ବହୁତ ସୁନ୍ଦର ସାନ୍ତାଳୀ ଗୀତ ଗାଉଛନ୍ତି।

blocks.markdown: Dare umul re durub kate unku ko jiraw kana.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱫᱟᱨᱮ ᱩᱢᱩᱞ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱩᱲᱩᱵ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱩᱱᱠᱩ ᱠᱚ ᱡᱤᱨᱟᱹᱣ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Dare umul re durub kate unku ko jiraw kana.

meta.meaning_bn: গাছের ছায়ায় বসে তারা বিশ্রাম নিচ্ছে।
meta.meaning_hi: वे पेड़ की छाया में बैठकर आराम कर रहे हैं।

blocks.markdown: Am do tumdah ar tamak ru em badaya?
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱢ ᱫᱚ ᱛᱩᱢᱫᱟᱜ ᱟᱨ ᱴᱟᱢᱟᱠ ᱨᱩ ᱮᱢ ᱵᱟᱰᱟᱭᱟ?

blocks.markdown: Hẽ, in do tumdag ru adi napay inj badaya.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱦᱮᱸ, ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱛᱩᱢᱫᱟᱜ ᱨᱩ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱤᱧ ᱵᱟᱰᱟᱭᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Hẽ, in do tumdag ru adi napay inj badaya.

blocks.markdown: Langde enej lagid kuri ar kora ko sapraw akana.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱞᱟᱜᱽᱬᱮ ᱮᱱᱮᱡ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱠᱩᱲᱤ ᱟᱨ ᱠᱚᱲᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱥᱟᱯᱲᱟᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Langde enej lagid kuri ar kora ko sapraw akana.

meta.meaning_hi: लागड़े नृत्य के लिए लड़कियाँ और लड़के सज-धज कर तैयार हैं।

blocks.markdown: Ale atu re do adi marang Baha porob huyuga.
blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱞᱮ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱵᱟᱦᱟ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ।
blocks.textLatin: Ale atu re do adi marang Baha porob huyuga.

titleLatin: The Clever Crow & The Water Pot
description: A classic graded reading story in Santali: A thirsty crow uses pebble stones to raise water in a pitcher.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱠᱟᱹᱦᱩ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱡᱩᱨ ᱛᱮᱛᱟᱝ ᱞᱮᱫᱮᱭᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Midtan kahu dag adi jur tetang ledeya.

data.meaning: A crow felt very thirsty for water.
data.meaning_bn: একটা কাক পানির জন্য খুব পিপাসা পেয়েছে।
data.meaning_hi: एक कौए को पानी की बहुत प्यास लगी।
data.meaning_or: ଏକ କାଉ ପାଣି ପାଇଁ ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ତୃଷାର୍ତ୍ତ ଅନୁଭବ କଲା।
data.meaning_en: A crow felt very thirsty for water.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱩᱱᱤ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱹᱫᱽ ᱫᱷᱟᱨᱮ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱴᱩᱠᱩᱡ ᱮ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱧᱟᱢ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Uni do bad dhare re midtan tukuj e nyel nyam keda.

data.meaning: He spotted a clay pitcher near the field.
data.meaning_bn: মাঠের কাছে একটা মাটির কলস দেখতে পেলেন।
data.meaning_hi: उसे मैदान के पास एक मिट्टी का घड़ा दिखाई दिया।
data.meaning_or: ସେ କ୍ଷେତ ନିକଟରେ ଏକ ମାଟି ପାତ୍ର ଦେଖିଲେ |
data.meaning_en: He spotted a clay pitcher near the field.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱴᱩᱠᱩᱡ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Tukuj re dag do adi latar re tahe kana.

data.meaning: In the pitcher, water was very low at the bottom.
data.meaning_bn: কলসিতে, নীচে জল খুব কম ছিল।
data.meaning_hi: घड़े में नीचे पानी बहुत कम था।
data.meaning_or: ପାତ୍ରରେ, ତଳ ଭାଗରେ ଜଳ ବହୁତ କମ୍ ଥିଲା |
data.meaning_en: In the pitcher, water was very low at the bottom.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱠᱟᱹᱦᱩ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱩᱫᱷᱤ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱫᱷᱤᱨᱤ ᱠᱮᱪᱮᱪ ᱴᱩᱠᱩᱡ ᱨᱮᱭ ᱠᱷᱟᱫᱽᱞᱮ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Kahu do budhi kate dhiri kecec tukuj rey khadle keda.

data.meaning: The clever crow dropped small pebbles into the pot.
data.meaning_bn: চালাক কাক পাত্রের মধ্যে ছোট নুড়ি ফেলে দিল।
data.meaning_hi: चतुर कौए ने बर्तन में छोटे-छोटे कंकड़ डाल दिये।
data.meaning_or: ଚତୁର କାଉ ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ପଥର ହାଣ୍ଡିରେ ପକାଇଲା |
data.meaning_en: The clever crow dropped small pebbles into the pot.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱫᱟᱜ ᱪᱚᱴ ᱛᱮ ᱨᱟᱠᱟᱵ ᱮᱱᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱠᱟᱹᱦᱩ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱩ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱨᱟᱹᱥᱠᱟᱹ ᱛᱮ ᱩᱰᱟᱹᱣ ᱮᱱᱟᱭ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Dag cot te rakab ena ar kahu dag nyu kate raska te udaw enay.

data.meaning: The water rose to the top and the crow drank joyfully and flew away.
data.meaning_bn: জল উপরে উঠল এবং কাক আনন্দে পান করে উড়ে গেল।
data.meaning_hi: पानी ऊपर तक बढ़ गया और कौवे ने मजे से पानी पी लिया और उड़ गया।
data.meaning_or: ପାଣି ଉପରକୁ ଉଠିଗଲା ଏବଂ କାଉ ଆନନ୍ଦରେ ପିଇ ଉଡିଗଲା |
data.meaning_en: The water rose to the top and the crow drank joyfully and flew away.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱠᱟᱹᱦᱩ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱴᱩᱠᱩᱡ ᱨᱮᱭ ᱠᱷᱟᱫᱽᱞᱮ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ?
blocks.textLatin: What did the crow drop into the pot to make the water rise?

data.question: What did the crow drop into the pot to make the water rise?
data.explanation: The crow dropped 'dhiri kecec' (pebble stones) into the pot.

titleOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱨᱡᱚᱢ ᱵᱤᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱡᱷᱚᱸᱠ ᱟᱨ ᱠᱩᱞ
description: An inspiring Santali forest story teaching courage and quick wit in the face of danger.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱥᱟᱨᱡᱚᱢ ᱵᱤᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱪᱚᱨᱚᱠ ᱡᱷᱚᱸᱠ ᱜᱟᱹᱥᱤᱭᱟᱹᱲ ᱜᱟᱥ ᱮ ᱡᱚᱢ ᱮᱫ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱫ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Marang Sarjom bir re midtan corok jhonk gasiyar gas e jom ed tahend.

data.meaning: In the great Sal forest, a graceful deer was grazing fresh green grass.
data.meaning_bn: মহান সাল বনে, একটি সুন্দর হরিণ তাজা সবুজ ঘাস চরছিল।
data.meaning_hi: विशाल साल वन में एक सुंदर हिरण ताज़ी हरी घास चर रहा था।
data.meaning_or: ମହାନ ସାଲ ଜଙ୍ଗଲରେ ଏକ ଅନୁଗୁଳ ହରିଣ ତାଜା ସବୁଜ ଘାସ ଚରାଉଥିଲା |
data.meaning_en: In the great Sal forest, a graceful deer was grazing fresh green grass.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱦᱟᱱᱛᱮ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱨᱮᱸᱜᱮᱡ ᱠᱩᱞ ᱦᱮᱡ ᱥᱮᱴᱮᱨ ᱮᱱᱟᱭ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Hante khon midtan rengej kul hej seter enay.

data.meaning: From across the grove, a hungry tiger arrived.
data.meaning_bn: গোয়ালের ওপার থেকে একটা ক্ষুধার্ত বাঘ এল।
data.meaning_hi: उपवन के उस पार से एक भूखा बाघ आया।
data.meaning_or: ଗ୍ରୀଭ୍ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରୁ ଏକ ଭୋକିଲା ବାଘ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲା |
data.meaning_en: From across the grove, a hungry tiger arrived.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱡᱷᱚᱸᱠ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱭ ᱵᱚᱛᱚᱨ ᱮᱱᱟ, ᱩᱱᱤ ᱫᱚ ᱥᱟᱦᱟᱥ ᱛᱮ ᱛᱤᱸᱜᱩ ᱮᱱᱟᱭ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Jhonk do bay botor ena, uni do sahas te tingu enay.

data.meaning: The deer did not panic; he stood tall with bravery.
data.meaning_bn: হরিণ ভয় পায়নি; তিনি সাহসিকতার সাথে লম্বা হয়ে দাঁড়িয়েছিলেন।
data.meaning_hi: हिरण घबराया नहीं; वह बहादुरी के साथ खड़ा रहा।
data.meaning_or: ହରିଣ ଭୟଭୀତ ହେଲେ ନାହିଁ; ସେ ସାହସର ସହିତ ଉଚ୍ଚରେ ଠିଆ ହେଲେ |
data.meaning_en: The deer did not panic; he stood tall with bravery.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱡᱷᱚᱸᱠ ᱮ ᱢᱮᱱ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ: 'ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱵᱩᱨᱩ ᱨᱤᱱᱤᱡ ᱫᱩᱜ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱠᱟᱱᱟᱹᱧ!'
blocks.textLatin: Jhonk e men keda: 'Iny do Marang Buru rinij dug hor kanany!'

data.meaning: The deer proclaimed: 'I am protected under the guardian spirit of Marang Buru!'
data.meaning_bn: হরিণ ঘোষণা করল: 'আমি মারাং বুরুর অভিভাবক আত্মার অধীনে সুরক্ষিত!'
data.meaning_hi: हिरण ने घोषणा की: 'मैं मारंग बुरु की संरक्षक भावना के तहत संरक्षित हूं!'
data.meaning_or: ହରିଣ ଘୋଷଣା କଲା: 'ମୁଁ ମାରଙ୍ଗ ବୁରୁଙ୍କ ଅଭିଭାବକ ଆତ୍ମା ​​ଅଧୀନରେ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ!'
data.meaning_en: The deer proclaimed: 'I am protected under the guardian spirit of Marang Buru!'

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱠᱩᱞ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱚᱛᱚᱨ ᱛᱮ ᱵᱤᱨ ᱵᱷᱤᱛᱨᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱫᱟᱹᱲ ᱠᱮᱫᱟᱭ ᱾ ᱵᱩᱫᱷᱤ ᱜᱮ ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱫᱟᱲᱮ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Kul do botor te bir bhitri te dar keday. Budhi ge marang dare kana.

data.meaning: The tiger fled into the forest. Wisdom is the greatest strength.
data.meaning_bn: বাঘ বনে পালিয়ে গেল। বুদ্ধি সবচেয়ে বড় শক্তি।
data.meaning_hi: बाघ जंगल में भाग गया। बुद्धि सबसे बड़ी ताकत है.
data.meaning_or: ବାଘ ଜଙ୍ଗଲକୁ ପଳାଇଲା। ଜ୍ଞାନ ହେଉଛି ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ ଶକ୍ତି |
data.meaning_en: The tiger fled into the forest. Wisdom is the greatest strength.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱱᱚᱣᱟ ᱠᱟᱹᱦᱱᱤ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱮ ᱥᱮᱪᱮᱫ ᱮᱫᱼᱟ?
blocks.textLatin: What moral does the story of the wise deer teach?

data.question: What moral does the story of the wise deer teach?
options: Budhi ge marang dare (Wisdom is the greatest strength)
data.explanation: 'Budhi ge marang dare' — Wisdom and presence of mind overcome danger.

titleLatin: The Two Birds of Marang Buru
description: A poetic traditional Santal tale celebrating kindness, melody, and mutual support in nature.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱵᱩᱨᱩ ᱯᱷᱮᱰ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱢᱟᱛᱠᱚᱢ ᱫᱟᱨᱮ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Marang Buru phed re midtan marang matkom dare tahe kana.

data.meaning: At the foot of the sacred mountain, there stood a magnificent Mahua tree.
data.meaning_bn: পবিত্র পাহাড়ের পাদদেশে একটি মহুয়া গাছ দাঁড়িয়ে ছিল।
data.meaning_hi: पवित्र पर्वत की तलहटी में एक भव्य महुआ का पेड़ खड़ा था।
data.meaning_or: ପବିତ୍ର ପର୍ବତର ପାଦଦେଶରେ ଏକ ଚମତ୍କାର ମହୁଆ ଗଛ ଛିଡା ହେଲା |
data.meaning_en: At the foot of the sacred mountain, there stood a magnificent Mahua tree.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱚᱱᱟ ᱫᱟᱨᱮ ᱨᱮ ᱵᱟᱨᱭᱟ ᱪᱮᱬᱮ ᱛᱩᱠᱟᱹ ᱠᱤᱱ ᱵᱮᱱᱟᱣ ᱞᱮᱫᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Ona dare re barya cene tuka kin benaw leda.

data.meaning: On that tree, two birds had built their cozy nest.
data.meaning_bn: সেই গাছে দুটি পাখি তাদের আরামদায়ক বাসা বেঁধেছিল।
data.meaning_hi: उस पेड़ पर दो पक्षियों ने अपना आरामदायक घोंसला बनाया था।
data.meaning_or: ସେହି ଗଛ ଉପରେ, ଦୁଇଟି ପକ୍ଷୀ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଆରାମଦାୟକ ବସା ନିର୍ମାଣ କରିଥିଲେ |
data.meaning_en: On that tree, two birds had built their cozy nest.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱮᱛᱟᱜ ᱵᱮᱲᱟ ᱵᱟᱱᱟᱨ ᱪᱮᱬᱮ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱤᱵᱤᱞ ᱨᱟᱦᱟ ᱛᱮ ᱠᱤᱱ ᱥᱮᱨᱮᱧ ᱮᱫ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱫ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Setag bera banar cene mid te sibil raha te kin sereny ed tahend.

data.meaning: Every dawn, both birds sang together in sweetest harmony.
data.meaning_bn: প্রতি ভোরে, উভয় পাখি মধুর সুরে একসাথে গান গায়।
data.meaning_hi: हर सुबह, दोनों पक्षी मधुर स्वर में एक साथ गाते थे।
data.meaning_or: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପ୍ରଭାତରେ, ଉଭୟ ପକ୍ଷୀ ଏକତ୍ର ମଧୁର ସମନ୍ୱୟରେ ଗୀତ ଗାଉଥିଲେ |
data.meaning_en: Every dawn, both birds sang together in sweetest harmony.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱡᱟᱹᱯᱩᱫ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱩᱱᱠᱤᱱ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱟᱨ ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱠᱤᱱ ᱜᱚᱲᱚᱣᱟᱫ ᱠᱤᱱᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Japud din re unkin mid ar midtan kin gorowad kina.

data.meaning: During heavy monsoon rains, they protected and helped one another.
data.meaning_bn: ভারী বর্ষার বৃষ্টিতে তারা একে অপরকে রক্ষা করত এবং সাহায্য করত।
data.meaning_hi: भारी मानसूनी बारिश के दौरान, उन्होंने एक-दूसरे की रक्षा की और मदद की।
data.meaning_or: ପ୍ରବଳ ବର୍ଷା ସମୟରେ ସେମାନେ ପରସ୍ପରକୁ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ଦେଇ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିଥିଲେ।
data.meaning_en: During heavy monsoon rains, they protected and helped one another.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱩᱞᱩᱠ ᱛᱮ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱ ᱨᱮᱜᱮ ᱡᱤᱭᱚᱱ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱨᱟᱹᱥᱠᱟᱹ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Suluk te tahen rege jiyon reyag sari raska menag-a.

data.meaning: In living with harmony and love lies the true joy of life.
data.meaning_bn: সম্প্রীতি এবং ভালবাসার সাথে বেঁচে থাকার মধ্যেই জীবনের আসল আনন্দ রয়েছে।
data.meaning_hi: सद्भाव और प्रेम से रहने में ही जीवन का सच्चा आनंद है।
data.meaning_or: ସ harmony ହାର୍ଦ୍ଦ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରେମ ସହିତ ବଞ୍ଚିବାରେ ଜୀବନର ପ୍ରକୃତ ଆନନ୍ଦ ମିଳେ |
data.meaning_en: In living with harmony and love lies the true joy of life.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱵᱟᱨᱭᱟ ᱪᱮᱬᱮ ᱚᱠᱟᱨᱮ ᱛᱩᱠᱟᱹ ᱠᱤᱱ ᱵᱮᱱᱟᱣ ᱞᱮᱫᱟ?
blocks.textLatin: Where did the two birds build their nest in the story?

data.question: Where did the two birds build their nest in the story?
data.explanation: The two birds nested on a 'matkom dare' (Mahua tree) near the sacred mountain.

description: Immerse in a village harvest narrative capturing the warmth, cattle blessing, and community feasts of Sohrai.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱦᱟᱹᱨᱤᱭᱟᱹᱲ ᱵᱟᱹᱫᱽ ᱠᱚ ᱥᱚᱱᱟ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱦᱳᱲᱳ ᱛᱮ ᱯᱮᱨᱮᱡ ᱮᱱᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Hariyar bad ko sona leka sasang horo te perej ena.

data.meaning: The green fields turned golden with ripe winter paddy.
data.meaning_bn: পাকা শীতের ধানে সবুজ মাঠগুলো সোনালী হয়ে উঠেছে।
data.meaning_hi: हरे-भरे खेत सर्दियों के पके धान से सुनहरे हो गए।
data.meaning_or: ସବୁଜ କ୍ଷେତଗୁଡିକ ପାଚିଲା ଶୀତ ଧାନ ସହିତ ସୁବର୍ଣ୍ଣରେ ପରିଣତ ହେଲା |
data.meaning_en: The green fields turned golden with ripe winter paddy.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱤᱱ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱠᱚ ᱥᱚᱦᱨᱟᱭ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱠᱚ ᱪᱚᱨᱚᱠ ᱠᱚ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Atu rin hor ko Sohrai porob lagid orag ko corok ko rong keda.

data.meaning: Village families painted and decorated their clay homes with wall murals.
data.meaning_bn: গ্রামের পরিবারগুলি তাদের মাটির ঘরগুলিকে প্রাচীরের ম্যুরাল দিয়ে আঁকা এবং সজ্জিত করেছে।
data.meaning_hi: गाँव के परिवारों ने अपने मिट्टी के घरों को दीवार भित्तिचित्रों से रंगा और सजाया।
data.meaning_or: ଗ୍ରାମ ପରିବାରମାନେ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ମାଟି ଘରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କାନ୍ଥ ମୁରାଲରେ ରଙ୍ଗ କରି ସଜାଇଥିଲେ |
data.meaning_en: Village families painted and decorated their clay homes with wall murals.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱜᱟᱹᱭ ᱰᱟᱝᱜᱽᱨᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱩᱱ ᱛᱮ ᱠᱚ ᱪᱩᱢᱟᱹᱣ ᱠᱮᱫ ᱠᱚᱣᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Gay dangra ko sagun te ko chumaw ked kowa.

data.meaning: Cattle were bathed, oiled, and blessed with sacred flower garlands.
data.meaning_bn: গবাদি পশুদের স্নান করানো হয়, তেল দেওয়া হয় এবং পবিত্র ফুলের মালা দিয়ে আশীর্বাদ করা হয়।
data.meaning_hi: मवेशियों को नहलाया गया, तेल लगाया गया और पवित्र फूल मालाओं से आशीर्वाद दिया गया।
data.meaning_or: ଗା attle ମାନଙ୍କୁ ସ୍ନାନ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା, ତେଲ ଦିଆଯାଉଥିଲା ଏବଂ ପବିତ୍ର ଫୁଲ ଫୁଲ ସହିତ ଆଶୀର୍ବାଦ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିଲା |
data.meaning_en: Cattle were bathed, oiled, and blessed with sacred flower garlands.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱧᱤᱫᱟᱹ ᱵᱮᱲᱟ ᱠᱩᱞᱦᱤ ᱟᱠᱷᱲᱟ ᱨᱮ ᱴᱟᱢᱟᱠ ᱟᱨ ᱛᱩᱢᱫᱟᱜ ᱨᱟᱦᱟ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱠᱚ ᱮᱱᱮᱡ ᱮᱱᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Nyida bera kulhi akhra re Tamak ar Tumdak raha te sanam ko enej ena.

data.meaning: At night, the whole village danced to the rhythm of Tamak and Tumdak drums.
data.meaning_bn: রাতে তমক আর তুমডাক ঢোলের তালে নেচে ওঠে গোটা গ্রাম।
data.meaning_hi: रात में पूरा गांव तमक और तुमडक ढोल की थाप पर नाचता रहा।
data.meaning_or: ରାତିରେ ପୂରା ଗାଁ ତାମାକ ଏବଂ ତୁମଡକ ଡ୍ରମର ଗୀତରେ ନାଚିଲା |
data.meaning_en: At night, the whole village danced to the rhythm of Tamak and Tumdak drums.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱱᱚᱣᱟ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱫᱚ ᱫᱷᱟᱹᱨᱛᱤ ᱟᱨ ᱡᱤᱵᱽ ᱠᱚ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱥᱟᱨᱦᱟᱣ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾
blocks.textLatin: Nowa porob do dharti ar jib ko lagid sarhaw reyag porob kana.

data.meaning: This celebration is a thanksgiving festival to Mother Earth and all living beings.
data.meaning_bn: এই উদযাপনটি পৃথিবী মাতা এবং সমস্ত জীবের জন্য একটি ধন্যবাদ উৎসব।
data.meaning_hi: यह उत्सव धरती माता और सभी जीवित प्राणियों को धन्यवाद देने का उत्सव है।
data.meaning_or: ଏହି ଉତ୍ସବ ମାତୃ ପୃଥିବୀ ଏବଂ ସମସ୍ତ ଜୀବଜନ୍ତୁଙ୍କୁ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ ଅର୍ପଣ ପର୍ବ |
data.meaning_en: This celebration is a thanksgiving festival to Mother Earth and all living beings.

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱥᱚᱦᱨᱟᱭ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
blocks.textLatin: Which festival is celebrated as a thanksgiving for harvest and cattle?

data.question: Which festival is celebrated as a thanksgiving for harvest and cattle?
data.explanation: Sohrai is the grand harvest and cattle thanksgiving festival of the Santal community.
